possible_direction_of_bias: May overstate or understate feasible DER export and voltage headroom
diagnostic_or_test: Compare representative cases with unbalanced AC benchmark
mitigation: Use OpenDSS or equivalent validated three-phase power flow before operational interpretation

possible_direction_of_bias: May misclassify treatment exposure and bias any estimated policy effect
diagnostic_or_test: Legal review of controlling tariff clause and application-specific eligibility
mitigation: Store policy regime ID and eligibility rationale per application

possible_direction_of_bias: May make aggregate request counts or mean durations appear to change absent process effects
diagnostic_or_test: Compare technology size export mode and review-level distributions
mitigation: Use application-level covariates and report standardized descriptive comparisons

possible_direction_of_bias: May understate duration if unresolved applications are dropped
diagnostic_or_test: Compare open-case share and follow-up by cohort
mitigation: Use survival methods with explicit administrative censoring

possible_direction_of_bias: May bias approval incidence and time-to-approval estimates
diagnostic_or_test: Compare withdrawal denial and still-open patterns across covariates
mitigation: Use Aalen-Johansen or multi-state methods and sensitivity analyses

failure_mode: Load and DER forecast errors are correlated
possible_direction_of_bias: May understate tail congestion or overstate hosting capacity if dependence is ignored
diagnostic_or_test: Estimate dependence from defensible historical data and stress common weather regimes
mitigation: Use joint scenarios or calibrated robust uncertainty sets

failure_mode: Line impedance and topology are inaccurate or stale
possible_direction_of_bias: May overstate or understate voltage sensitivity and upgrade value
diagnostic_or_test: Validate model inputs against engineering records and benchmark power flow
mitigation: Version feeder inputs and perform parameter sensitivity

failure_mode: Aggregate EDC request counts are mistaken for performance rates
possible_direction_of_bias: Usually overstates comparability and can reverse rankings after exposure normalization
diagnostic_or_test: Check denominator availability and unit of observation
mitigation: Do not report rates without an appropriate denominator and linked cohort outcomes

failure_mode: Synthetic parameters are presented as observed utility values
diagnostic_or_test: Audit parameter provenance and label synthetic inputs in output
mitigation: Separate illustrative scenario results from empirical results in all figures and tables

failure_mode: Concurrent policy or investment changes are omitted
possible_direction_of_bias: Can attribute effects to the wrong intervention
diagnostic_or_test: Construct a dated intervention chronology by EDC and application eligibility
mitigation: Use explicit exposure mapping and avoid causal claims when overlap cannot be resolved
